mentorNotes: Aurora resources are optional reflection, creativity, rest, breathing, and wellness-support tools. They are not medical, psychological, psychiatric, or therapeutic treatment. Mentors should never present an Aurora room as diagnosis, emergency care, or a substitute for professional support. Spiritual rooms are optional and should be offered only when relevant to the learner's stated interest or context.
